Clinical Evaluation

Common Concerns We Review

Persistent joint or back discomfort can make routine movements distressing. Share your symptoms and any X-rays or reports on WhatsApp so Dr. Surabhi can guide your right next step.

🚶‍♂️

Difficulty Walking or Climbing Stairs

Morning stiffness in the knees, swelling after walking, or a grating / grinding sensation that makes climbing up or down stairs challenging.

🪑

Pain While Sitting, Standing or Getting Up

Sharp or aching lower-back stiffness when getting out of bed, rising from chairs, or standing for more than 15 minutes.

⏱️

Persistent Knee or Back Discomfort

Joint pain or sciatica tingling that has persisted over weeks or months, and has not responded satisfactorily to temporary pain relief tablets or generic ointments.

📋

Clarity on Your X-Ray or MRI Reports

Unsure what your X-ray or MRI means for non-surgical Ayurvedic options? Share it in WhatsApp for Dr. Surabhi's initial review and guidance.

Practitioner Background

Meet Dr. Surabhi Vaidya

Dr. Surabhi Sunil Vaidya (BAMS, MBA) is an Ayurvedic physician and the founder of Charak Health Solutions in Thane West. With over 15 years of dedicated clinical practice in Thane, her clinical focus is on helping patients understand chronic knee osteoarthritis, lumbar spine discomfort, and sciatica through the foundational diagnostic methods of Ayurveda.

What Dr. Surabhi Looks For in Your Review

When you share your concern on WhatsApp—or visit in person—Dr. Surabhi takes time to evaluate your situation carefully:

  • Symptom & Trigger History: Understanding when your pain flares up, morning stiffness duration, and daily mobility limitations.
  • Diagnostic Report Review: Careful review of any X-rays, MRI scans, and blood reports you share in the WhatsApp chat window.
  • Clear Next-Step Recommendation: Guidance on whether preliminary home/lifestyle care helps, or if an in-clinic Naadi Pariksha & physical joint check is needed.
  • Honest Medical Guidance: A transparent perspective on whether Ayurvedic therapies are suitable for your stage of condition, or whether orthopaedic referral is indicated.
